icons.description: Choose the button symbols shown for a controller. Auto uses Xbox symbols.
SkipPressStart.description: Continue past the first press-start prompt, keeping the normal player and save-selection flow.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the game window while it is active.
plugin.name: Resident Evil Revelations Fusion Fix
fovfactor.description: Scales the ordinary third-person player camera from 0.5 to 2.0. 1.0 is neutral; the horizontal view is capped at 150 degrees. Aiming, scripted views and camera transitions keep their original field of view. The game already widens the view with the screen (Hor+).
fpslimit.description: The frame rate cap of the game's VARIABLE frame rate option (120 in the original game).
windowmode.description: The window when the game's own Full Screen option is off: with a frame, or borderless. A window as big as the screen has its frame outside the screen.
DisableDamageOverlay.description: Hide the overlay shown at low health.
LightSyncRGB.description: Show the player's health on supported Logitech keyboards (Logitech G HUB).
hudaspect.description: Auto anchors equipment, objectives and the minimap to the screen edges. Use 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, another W:H ratio or a decimal to keep them in a centered box. Other widgets remain centered.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the startup logos and the notices on the way to the main menu that only offer OK (the autosave notice, and the message that the RESIDENT EVIL.NET service is not available). Choices and online sign-in are kept.
ModernControls.description: Free shoulder camera, camera-relative movement and aiming toward the view. Walk while aiming, using the knife, reloading or changing weapons. Quick turn and side/back dodges. Reload with X/Square on pad or your configured keyboard key. Offline only.
KnifeParry.description: A well-timed knife swing parries ordinary Ooze melee swings and staggers the attacker for a melee follow-up. Does not block grabs, projectiles, explosions or boss attacks. Offline only.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.restarthelp: Applies the next time the game starts
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply changes.
menu.presethelp: Choose with Left/Right, then confirm to apply. Vanilla keeps the original logo sequence and cinematic borders. Recommended and Enhanced skip the logos, add side borders to cutscenes and enable RGB lighting. Player preferences and values shared by every preset are kept. Restore defaults resets every setting.
menu.helphint: F1: full help. You can also select Details.
menu.pluginshelp: Manage this fix and other installed plugins.
textlanguage.description: Choose the language of the fix’s settings and help. Automatic follows the Windows interface language.
checkforupdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
cutsceneborders.description: Cutscenes are framed for 16:9. Pillarbox keeps that framing on wider screens with black bars at the sides; Off shows the wider view. Changes apply at once.
pauseonfocusloss.description: Pause while another window is active. Turn off to keep the game running in the background in windowed and borderless modes; fullscreen always pauses. Applies immediately.
